title: Flood Advisory issued November 3 at 2:23PM MST until November 3 at 5:30PM MST by NWS Grand Junction CO
description: * WHAT...Flooding caused by recent rainfall and runoff is expected. * WHERE...South Central Archuleta County in southwestern Colorado... * WHEN...Until 530 PM MST. * IMPACTS...Flooding in low-lying areas. Water over roadways. River or stream flows are elevated. * ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 223 PM MST, Flooding is ongoing in the advisory area. - This includes the following streams and drainages... Cat Creek, Montezuma Creek, Blanco, Rio, Navajo River, Arroyo Escondido and San Juan River. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Gato, Juanita and Pagosa Junction. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
text:
What: Flooding caused by recent rainfall and runoff is expected. Where: South Central Archuleta County in southwestern Colorado... When: Until 5:30 PM Mountain Standard Time.

Impacts: Flooding in low-lying areas. Water over roadways. River or stream flows are elevated.
